channel.title: Skills in demand: weekly changes
channel.description: What changed in AI, ML, forward-deployed and Python job postings this week.

item.title: Skills market, week of 2026-11-22
item.description:
• 40,759 live tech postings in the last 30 days (+4,006 since 2026-11-19).
  • Biggest moves since last week: Distributed systems 19% (−0.5 pp).
  • New on the radar: KI (150 companies), IBM (113 companies), IA (111 companies), DNA (110 companies).
  • Median advertised pay in SG: SGD 90,000 a year, from 4,658 ads.
  • Median advertised pay in US: USD 205,000 a year, from 10,699 ads.

item.title: Skills market, week of 2026-11-19
item.description:
• 36,753 live tech postings in the last 30 days (+533 since 2026-11-19).
  • Biggest moves since last week: Unit / integration testing 8% (+1.3 pp), Spark 6% (+1.0 pp).
  • New on the radar: STEM (125 companies), FSA (123 companies), HSA (117 companies), MDM (115 companies).
  • Median advertised pay in SG: SGD 90,000 a year, from 4,237 ads.
  • Median advertised pay in US: USD 207,000 a year, from 9,958 ads.

item.title: Skills market, week of 2026-11-18
item.description:
• 22,651 live tech postings in the last 30 days (+4,839 since 2026-11-18).
  • Biggest moves since last week: Financial services / banking domain 16% (−16.9 pp), Pre-sales / solution architecture / PoCs 9% (−10.9 pp), Observability / tracing / monitoring 24% (−9.7 pp).
  • New on the radar: DNS (120 companies), SIEM (114 companies), TCP (114 companies), CA (113 companies).
  • Median advertised pay in SG: SGD 90,000 a year, from 1,912 ads.
  • Median advertised pay in US: USD 216,100 a year (-2%), from 7,370 ads.
